task_eligibility: one small, single-purpose change per task inside the ONE writable repo granted by the boundary — no marathon tasks, no cross-repo refactors
every task is approved by the named code owner BEFORE it runs (the task-set approval gate; a task the owner did not approve is not eligible)
the set must include ambiguity, a neighboring-service dependency, one operator intervention and one controlled infrastructure failure, alongside ordinary useful work

tasks must be completable by the supported workflow on the qualified native profile (gitlab-ce-v1) with bounded credentials — no task may require production secrets, deploy authority or merge authority
acceptance: the INDEPENDENT ORACLE decides acceptance: the contracted verification job (smoke) is green ON THE CANDIDATE SHA and the contracted content/outcome check passes against the candidate branch
customer acceptance is SEPARATE from PR/MR creation, harness success and test success — a human may reject a green candidate, and the rejection stays in the final denominator
every task and attempt is recorded, including rejected, abandoned and manually rescued work — failures and drops stay in the ledger and the budget
manual rescues are OBSERVED and recorded (what the human did, when), never inferred from success labels
available_data: the ONE writable repo granted for the pilot (disposable for the lab stage-1 leg; the partner's repo named at signing for the partner stages)
read-only evidence from the named neighbor repo(s) the task set declares — cited at exact OIDs, never written
CI logs and pipeline status for the candidate sha on the verification contract (FORGE_REQUIRED_JOBS)
the runbook (docs/operations/) and the qualification profile record for the deployed lab
prohibited_operations: automatic merge — the bot never merges, even when every check is green
automatic deploy or any production deployment
production secrets — bounded credentials only, inside the named secrets scope
repository write scope beyond the one granted writable repo (neighbor repos stay read-only)
extra data access beyond the declared available data (no scope creep by configuration)
force-push, branch deletion or any destructive compensation on human-edited branches

baseline.method: PENDING — the customer's ACTUAL workflow is measured per axis at signing (assisted coding time, reviewer effort, operations intervention, waiting, measured separately); an authored baseline is refused for this ladder

notes: HONEST CUSTOMER STATE: pending-recruitment. A named external customer (buyer/user + code owner) is a prerequisite the machinery cannot fabricate — recruiting is the maintainer's act. The supervised-batch and operational-sample stages fail closed until the customer, the task-set approval and the observed baseline exist.

The one-observed-task stage may run against the forge LAB (disposable project, real model through the qualified profile, spend bounded at 1.00 USD) as the machinery-validation leg: that validates the MACHINERY, not customer demand.
The window is frozen at signing; until then it stays empty rather than invented.
